Get from [[Wehhan Terraces]] over [[Chantry of Secrets]] to [[Tihark Orchard (outpost)|Tihark Orchard]] to do the next mission.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Travel to [[Yatendi Canyons]] and find [[Kehanni|Kehanni Nutu]], priestess of [[Lyssa]].
* Meet with the [[Seeker of Whispers]].
* Meet [[Kehanni]] in [[Vehtendi Valley]]. Obtain an invitation to the [[Festival of Lyss]].
* Travel through the [[Forum Highlands]]. Meet [[Priestess Haila]].
* Wash the dirt, grime, and heket blood from your armor and gear in the [[Font of Lyss]].
* Speak with Priestess Haila to gain a sneak peek at the party.
* See [[Event Planner Kazsha]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 4,000 [[Experience]]
* 400 [[Gold]]
* [[Trade Contract]]
* Trade Contract

===Environmental changes===
* While this quest is active, the [[boss]]es [[Bohdalz the Furious]] and [[Jarimiya the Unmerciful]] do not [[spawn]] in [[Vehtendi Valley]].

==Walkthrough==
Start in Wehhan Terraces. Follow the path in the map to point 1 and talk to Kehanni. Follow the path to Chantry of Secrets, and talk to the Seeker of Whispers inside (point 2).  Follow the path into and through Vehtendi Valley to point 3, where the quest will update.  Follow either the green (through Forum Highlands) or the red path (via [[the Kodash Bazaar]]) to Priestess Haila outside the Kodash Bazaar. If you wish to enter the Kodash Bazaar, you can also follow the green path and then continue into the Bazaar before talking to the priestess. There you can wash yourself in the Font of Lyss and she will send you into [[Tihark Orchard (outpost)|Tihark Orchard]].

If you already have the Kodash Bazaar unlocked, you can skip most of this quest by starting from the objective that requires using the Font of Lyss.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Kuwame'''
:''"The strangest thing happened just a few moments ago. A devout sister of [[Lyssa]] inquired about visitors she was expecting from afar. I told her I hadn't seen anyone and she left. Then out of nowhere you appear! Her name was [[Kehanni]]. She said she would be waiting in the '''Yatendi Canyons'''. I can only assume she's waiting for you..."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I will seek this priestess and discover what she wants.
|decline = Are you sure you haven't been hitting the [[Bottle of Grog|grog]]?
|ask = The priestess is waiting for you in '''Yatendi Canyons'''.  Don't keep her waiting. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Kehanni''' (Yatendi Canyons - with [[Tahlkora]] in [[party]])
:''"Tahlkora! It's been years since we went to school together. I see you have fallen in with quite the group of heroes. A mysterious man approached me the other day while I was tending the old temple. He is a member of [[Order of Whispers|an old and powerful order]]. He told me to pray here and wait for your coming. Through my meditations, Lyssa showed me the perils you have faced, and I learned of the evils of Warmarshal [[Varesh]].''

:''The mysterious man told me he would wait for you in the [[Chantry of Secrets]]. We will meet again in [[Vehtendi Valley|Yehtendi Valley]] {{sic}}. I have foreseen it."''

'''Kehanni''' (Yatendi Canyons - without Tahlkora)
:''"The guard gave you my message. Good. I am Kehanni Nutu, priestess of the revered goddess Lyssa. A mysterious man approached me the other day while I was tending the old temple. He is a member of an old and powerful order. He told me to pray here and wait for your coming. Through my meditations, Lyssa showed me the perils you have faced, and I learned of the evils of Warmarshal Varesh.''

:''The mysterious man told me he would wait for you in the Chantry of Secrets. We will meet again in Yehtendi Valley {{sic}}. I have foreseen it."''

'''Seeker of Whispers'''
:''"Welcome to the Chantry of Secrets, <[[character]] name>. So, you seek to rally the princes against the darkness creeping into this land. Indeed, your goals and that of our order are aligned. Unfortunately, the princes protect themselves with ignorance and opulence, but you are just in time for the [[Festival of Lyss]]. Kehanni will help you obtain an invitation. Attend the festival and convince the princes that Varesh has motives other than just your capture and their "protection." When the time comes, we will aid in your fight against much darker abominations."''

:'''Priest Jeshek:''' ''"To what do I owe this unexpected pleasure? Who are your friends?"''
:'''Kehanni:''' ''"Lyssa has granted me a vision, Master. A great evil seeks to strike at the heart of our land. These heroes have come to fight."''
:'''Kehanni:''' ''"We need your help arranging meetings with each of the three princes. We must warn them of the impending danger."''
:'''Priest Jeshek:''' ''"Alas, my poor old legs are as frail as dried reeds; else I would join you on this crusade"''
:'''Priest Jeshek:''' ''"But, you needn't lug my crippled shell around for I have something you will find useful."''
:'''Priest Jeshek:''' ''"Kehanni, my dear, take this from me, will you? I am so weak"''
:'''Kehanni:''' :''"What is it, holy one?"''
:'''Priest Jeshek:''' ''"It is an invitation to a party in the [[Garden of Seborhin]]. All three princes will be in attendance."''
:'''Priest Jeshek:''' ''"If you wish to speak to them, this is your chance. Take my invitation and go. As you can see, the slightest bit of excitement may cause this frail body to crumble to dust!"''
:'''Kehanni:''' ''"Go on ahead. Just show you invitation to [[Priestess Haila]]. She can be found at the [[Grand Forum of Vabb]], in the Forum Highlands. I am going to stay here for awhile and spend some time with Priest Jeshek. We shall meet again, before the party."''

'''Priestess Haila'''
:''"Just look at you! All covered in dirt and grime. You smell of [[heket]] blood, too! You would do well to cleanse yourself before attempting to talk with the princes of [[Vabbi]]! Speak to me after you have used the [[Font of Lyss]] to clean your [[armor]]. I will then do what I can to help."''

;Priestess Haila
:''"So you have Jeshek's invitation. That old man would never leave his home even if Lyssa herself was to show up at the Festival! They are still setting up in the Garden of Seborhin, but most of the princes are already inside with their entourages. I can let you in to look around before the celebration starts. Kehanni is already there, and she can give you a quick preview.''
::{{yes|ingame}} '''Thank you. It will be great to get a sneak peek."'''
:::''When you are ready I'll let you in to look around.''
::::{{yes|ingame}} '''We are ready.''' (sent to [[Rally The Princes (cinematic)]])
::::{{no|ingame}} '''We are not ready yet.'''

{{anomaly| You can skip the earlier objectives of this quest and go straight to the Font of Lyss and then talk to Priestess Haila to go to Tihark where you can complete the quest.}}
{{anomaly|Priestess Haila says that Kehanni is already at the Garden of Seborhin, but in fact, she's standing right next to her.}}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Event Planner Kazsha'''
:''"Oh good! More attendees for the Festival of Lyss! And foreigners nonetheless! It seems you only have one invitation so you will have to attend separately."''

==Notes==
* After completion of [[Tihark Orchard]] you will find yourself in Kodash Bazaar. The only point in going there before you complete the Tihark Orchard mission is to unlock it a little bit earlier.
* If you accept the quest reward for this quest with a full inventory, you will not receive the trade contracts and you might not be able to continue the primary quest line.
